# lines-bezier

a cubic Bézier that follows the mouse

Category: shapes

![lines-bezier](../demos/lines-bezier.gif)

## Run it

```sh
cd lines-bezier && bb run   # from this demo (or jolt run, jolt -M:run)
bb lines-bezier             # from the repo root (or jolt -M:lines-bezier)
```

## About

raylib [shapes] example - a cubic Bézier curve whose end point follows the
mouse. DrawLineBezier takes Vector2 by value (unbindable), so the curve is
sampled in Clojure and drawn as line! segments. See
docs/guide/rlgl-immediate-mode.md.
